title: ci: remove git safe.directory workaround from container jobs
body:
## Problem

Four container jobs in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` run a manual workaround:

```yaml
- name: fix git safe.directory
  run: git config --global --add safe.directory "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
```

This appears in `validate`, `doccheck`, `test_skopeo`, and `ostree_rs_ext`.

## Why

Sandbox GHA migration review asked why this is needed when `actions/checkout` already configures `safe.directory`. mtrmac ACK'd removing it but it was never finished.

Draft PR #2885 started this work but remains `[draft/DNM]` and stale.


## Related

- Draft PR #2885 — started but not merged
- Sandbox PR #1 review (mtrmac)

comments.body:
@timcoding1988 this keeps getting attempted so I had a look at why it fails.

deleting the step breaks validate. #2938's job log has it at lines 231 and 388, then exits 128:

    fatal: detected dubious ownership in repository at '/__w/skopeo/skopeo'

checkout does set safe.directory, but into a temp HOME under RUNNER_TEMP that it removes when its own step ends, so nothing is left for the next step. the manual one sticks because the container's real HOME is a bind mount that lasts the whole job.

no CI run is needed to see it, the same image does it:

    $ docker run --rm ghcr.io/podman-container-tools/skopeo_cidev bash -c '...'
    uid=0(root) gid=0(root) groups=0(root)
    git version 2.55.0
    workspace owner: uid=1000 gid=1000   euid now: 0

    == WITHOUT the workaround ==
    fatal: detected dubious ownership in repository at '/__w/skopeo/skopeo'
    tree_status.sh rc=128

    == with the workaround ==
    tree is clean
    tree_status.sh rc=0

I have a version that works using GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_0/VALUE_0 at workflow level, it coversostree_rs_ext too. happy to put it up if that shape is wanted.
